item.title: Mon Forest Towns Partnership launches website to explore national forest, communities
item.description: You can learn more about the Mon Forest Town Partnership and all the activities available within the Monongahela Forest on its website.

item.title: Home Federal Credit Union hosts Valentine's Day drive for local nursing homes
item.description: This month, Home Federal Credit Union is hosting a Valentine's Day drive to benefit local nursing homes in north-central West Virginia.

item.title: Morgantown welcomes West Virginia student choirs for annual WVACDA conference
item.description: The West Virginia American Choral Directors Association (WVCDA) is holding its annual conference in Morgantown over the next few days, inviting the best junior high, high school and collegiate choir members throughout the state.

item.title: Where is West Virginia mentioned in the Epstein files?
item.description: Last week's sudden release of the Epstein files prompted many to dig in searching for names of celebrities, executives and other people of interest, but there's one subject that appears several hundred times—West Virginia.

item.title: Shinnston woman auditions for American Idol
item.description: There's an abundant amount of talent that lives in the mountains of West Virginia, but one lucky local is making her big break on a national stage.

item.title: WVU Cancer Institute becomes first in state to offer new cancer therapy
item.description: The West Virginia Cancer Institute in Morgantown is now the first healthcare facility in the state to offer a newly regulated cancer therapy, Inlexzo.

item.title: Harrison County Schools bans Valentine's Day gifts
item.description: With Valentine's Day right around the corner, some local students are being cautioned against bringing gifts to school for their special someone.

item.title: New West Virginia resolution would require governors to be born in-state
item.description: While many of us are West Virginia born and raised, sometimes our politicians are not, and a new resolution in the Legislature is seeking to change that.

item.title: Healthnet called after fire breaks out at Harrison County home
item.description: Healthnet was dispatched on Thursday after a structure fire broke out at a home in rural Harrison County.

item.title: Morgantown man charged after task force members find fentanyl in his anus
item.description: A man has been arrested and is facing charges after task force members in Morgantown say they found him in possession of drugs, including inside his body.
